description:
These snowmobile trails are managed through a partnership agreement with the Eagle Valley Snowmobile Club.

For additional information, visit the Eagle Valley Snowmobile Club website:
http://sledsicamous.com

Trail fees are in effect throughout the winter operating season (Nov 1 - May 31).

Always check the avalanche conditions before you go. https://www.avalanche.ca/planning/trip-planner
title: Owlhead Snowmobile Trails
